notes:
OWNER SPECIFICATION REVIEW EVENT, r11 row 8 (R11-014), 2026-09-16. Recorded under the r11
closure mandate's AFK review authority on an explicit owner ruling, transcribed verbatim in
work/r11-campaign/RULINGS-OWNER-10.md.

WHAT MOVED: `title`, `statement`, `security_consequence` and `scope`.

THE DEFECT. Inside the proved function the degraded fork was gated on
`now - claims.iat <= P + skew` — the age of the assertion the CALLER presented. During an
outage the issuer keeps minting, so a caller that refetches is served for the whole outage
however long it runs. The proxy compensated with `DegradedWindow` (#915, monotonic,
measured), but that fix lived at ONE call site rather than in the value that decides, and the
contract said in as many words "Establishes the opt-in, not the bound" — so any second
enforcement point built on this `pub` API reintroduced *served for the whole outage* with no
local signal and no contract to catch it.

THE RULING, AND WHY NOT THE ROW'S OWN FIX. The row asked for an outage-clock fact as an
argument. The owner ruled against it: elapsed outage time is replica HISTORY, not a property
of one assertion, and a caller-supplied witness whose provenance is not itself owned and
sealed MOVES the assumption rather than proving the bound. THM-0005 is therefore NOT
broadened to claim a cross-call property its function cannot establish by itself. The
authority split the architecture had already found is made explicit instead:

    check_admission          decides ONE call against assertion + authoritative snapshot
    DegradedWindow/Enforcer  decides whether THIS REPLICA may still operate after losing
                             the authority

WHAT THE CONTRACT NOW SAYS. Two kinds of Ok, as two variants rather than a flag:
`AdmissionVerdict::Live` implies the authoritative current-state relation held;
`AdmissionVerdict::DegradedCandidate` implies the authority was unreachable, the deployment
opted in, and the assertion-level freshness rules hold — and is NOT permission to serve. The
scope states in capitals that this contract does not establish the replica-wide elapsed-outage
P bound and that no reading may supply one, names the freshness term as the CALLER's to
satisfy, and points at `unit://proxy.admission_currency_gate` as where the real bound lives.

THIS IS A NARROWING, NOT A BROADENING. Every conjunct the old contract established is still
established, restated per arm. What is added is a statement of what it does NOT establish —
which was true before and unsaid, and whose absence is the defect. The `degraded: bool` is
removed from `VerifiedAdmission`: a boolean is a thing a second enforcement point reads past,
and `ExAdmissionVerdict` is registered TRANSPARENT precisely so the prover must tell the two
arms apart. No compatibility wrapper maps `DegradedCandidate` back onto unconditional success;
the ruling forbids it, because that reproduces R11-014.

THE PUBLIC API CHANGE IS AUTHORIZED by the same ruling. `check_admission` returns
`AdmissionVerdict`; `VerifiedAdmission` loses its boolean.
